title: cyclopogon obliquus
intro: Cyclopogon obliquus, commonly known as the "Yellow Vanda Orchid," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclopogon obliquus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
